params.body:
A garage whose only open item was a transport waiting for it got no daily mail. `DealerRepository::getAllWithWorklistItems` selected a dealer on unfinished vehicles, expiring Car-Passes or untreated leads (or a user with unread release notes), never on transports. So the transport only appeared in the mail on a day when something else was open too.

Since #1077, `Dealer::OpenTransport` holds only transports that wait for the garage (a request it did not finish, or a price to agree to and pay). That is work in the same sense as an untreated lead, so it is now enough on its own to select the dealer.

## Change

- `getAllWithWorklistItems` also selects on `OpenTransport`.
- Who gets the line is unchanged: only a user who passes the transport gate, and a user with no line he can open gets no mail (`WorklistDigest::lines`).
- R P1-2.11 and R P1-2.12 say so, with the date.

## Tests

In `WorklistMailTest`:
- `test_a_garage_whose_only_open_item_is_a_transport_gets_the_mail`: fails on `main`, passes here.
- `test_a_garage_whose_only_transports_are_done_or_ours_gets_no_mail`: transports in planning, delivered, cancelled or waiting for a price do not trigger a mail.

Full suite: 3219 passed. The 6 failures in `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest` fail on `main` on this machine too, and are green on CI.

Closes #1078

params.title: Send the daily mail to a garage whose only open item is a transport
